evidence.quote:
Once when I was doing a hitch with the Shaulan Space Guard out Scorpio
way
evidence.paraphrase: The narrator situates the story in a far-off stellar location with a space guard organization.

evidence.quote:
now the two of us
were out on a servicing check of the orbital beacons and relays and
rescue depots of the five planets of the Shaulan system
evidence.paraphrase: The characters work maintaining orbital infrastructure across a five-planet star system.

evidence.quote:
Our ship was an
ionic jeep that looked like a fancy fountain pen, but was very roomy for
three men\u2014one of them imaginary.
evidence.paraphrase: The spacecraft is described as an ion-powered small vessel.

evidence.quote:
my partner Jeff Bogart developed just about the most harmless
psychosis you could imagine: he got himself an imaginary companion.
evidence.paraphrase: The narrator describes his partner developing an imaginary companion during the voyage.

evidence.quote:
Every duty orbit, fifty scientists
come with permission from the Commandant to hang some automatic research
gadget on the hull.
evidence.paraphrase: Scientists routinely attach automated research devices to ships for space experiments.

evidence.quote:
a huge flattened band
of gold-plated aluminum, little more than foil-thick, attached crosswise
just in front of the tail and sticking out twenty feet on each side. I
don\u2019t know what it was there for\u2014maybe to measure the effects of space
on a Moebius strip
evidence.paraphrase: A research apparatus on the hull is speculated to measure space effects on a Moebius strip.

evidence.quote:
an ionic jet\u2019s only good space-to-space. It\u2019s not for
heavy-G work; ours could deliver only one-half G at max and was doing
less than one-quarter now.
evidence.paraphrase: The narrator explains the performance limits of the ion jet's low acceleration.

evidence.quote:
the beam would fire for hours, building up to a terminal velocity of
fifteen miles a second and carrying the ship far, far away from lonely
Joe Hansen.
evidence.paraphrase: The ion beam slowly accumulates to a high terminal velocity over hours.

evidence.quote:
from straight on it\u2019s a lot brighter than an arc light\u2014it\u2019s almost as
tight as a laser beam\u2014and I didn\u2019t want to think about what it would do
to me
evidence.paraphrase: The ion jet seen head-on is a dangerously concentrated beam like a laser.

evidence.quote: I saw the ship begin to slide past Shaula.
evidence.paraphrase: The narrator realizes the ship is departing while he is stranded outside in space.

evidence.quote:
I unshipped my suit-antenna and pulled it out to full length\u2014about eight
feet\u2014and fished around with it in the direction of the beam.
evidence.paraphrase: The narrator tests the proximity of the beam by probing with his antenna.

evidence.quote:
when I drew it back I could
see three inches of the tip were gone and the next couple inches were
pitted.
evidence.paraphrase: The probe reveals the destructive effect of the ion beam by melting the antenna tip.

evidence.quote:
if he got her up near the speed of light, when by
the General Theory of Relativity the line ought to be shortened enough
so that I could hop aboard if I were sudden enough about it
evidence.paraphrase: The narrator jokingly reasons about relativistic length contraction at near-light speed.

evidence.quote:
I heard him say, \u201cWake up, Joseph! I\u2019m going to tell you your
faults again. I got a new way of cataloguing them\u2014chronologically.
evidence.paraphrase: Jeff continues addressing his imaginary companion, cataloguing faults.

evidence.quote: nobody else for five million miles.
evidence.paraphrase: The two men are isolated in deep space, far from anyone else.

evidence.quote:
with \u201cUnited States\u201d
standing out big as life on the ship\u2019s living quarters. United States of
Shaula, of course.
evidence.paraphrase: A future nation, the United States of Shaula, is referenced as owner of the ship.

evidence.quote:
Right away I gave a couple of tugs on the line and began to close slowly
with the tail.
evidence.paraphrase: After the beam shuts off, the narrator hauls himself safely back to the ship.
